overview: The Medford City Council addressed several municipal matters, focusing on cable television contract renewals and public access television, substance abuse initiatives, and complaints over parking kiosks. The council voted to request legal opinions and a seven-day delay on the Comcast renewal, referred a Substance Abuse Coordinator ordinance to committee, and forwarded kiosk grievances to city administration.

items.title: Substance Abuse Coordinator Ordinance and Prevention Efforts
items.summary: Referred a proposed personnel ordinance establishing a municipal Substance Abuse Coordinator to the Committee of the Whole, and approved an order requesting public safety officials update the council on Narcan deployment and overdose statistics.

items.title: Resolution on Youth Mentoring Program
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the mayor to establish a citywide youth mentoring program, amended to have the Rules Committee explore council-sponsored civic mentorship opportunities.

items.title: Comcast Contract Renewal and Public Access Television
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting the city solicitor's opinion on council approval requirements for the 10-year Comcast contract, asking the mayor not to sign for seven days, and requesting a seat on negotiations, public hearings, and franchise fee records.

items.title: Citizen Street Recovery Program
items.summary: Approved a request for the mayor to report back on establishing a citizen-involved program to document and address potholes, sidewalks, and street lighting issues.

items.title: Cradock Bridge Reconstruction Update
items.summary: Approved requesting a project timeline and status update from the Massachusetts Department of Transportation regarding the Cradock Bridge rehabilitation.

items.title: Downtown Pay-to-Park Kiosk Complaints
items.summary: Approved forwarding patron and business complaints about downtown parking kiosks to the mayor and Traffic Commission, while requesting a 60-day revenue report, snow emergency enforcement data, and an appearance by the Traffic Commission.

items.title: Commendations, Condolences, and Records
items.summary: Adopted commendations for high school championship athletic teams, passed condolences for deceased residents, approved corrected records from February 17 and March 10, and kept February 24 records tabled.
